Double-quoted strings are ignored. Inside a string, a backslash escapes the
next character. An unterminated string makes the input unbalanced.
"""

_PAIRS = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}
_OPENERS = set(_PAIRS.values())


def balanced(s: str) -> bool:
    stack = []
    in_string = False
    i = 0
    n = len(s)

    while i < n:
        c = s[i]
        if in_string:
            if c == '\\':
                i += 2
                continue
            if c == '"':
                in_string = False
        elif c == '"':
            in_string = True
        elif c in _OPENERS:
            stack.append(c)
        elif c in _PAIRS:
            if not stack or stack.pop() != _PAIRS[c]:
                return False
        i += 1

    return not in_string and not stack
